department: Physics Institute (Faculty of Mathematics and Physics)

deadline.value: The page gives acceptance deadlines only relative to committee meetings (three weeks before for foreign degrees), with no dates, and no funding round.
deadline.quote: for foreign university degrees: three weeks before the meeting of the doctoral committee

gre_subject.value: No GRE Subject test is mentioned on the physics doctoral pages.

supervisor.value: Students must finalise a doctoral agreement with a supervisor before they can be accepted as doctoral candidates.
supervisor.quote: The prerequisite for acceptance as a doctoral candidate is the finalization of a doctoral agreement with the supervisor.

funding.value: The page invites applications to research-group positions but states no funding rule.
funding.quote: Please apply for a doctoral position directly at one of the research groups at the institute

entry_route.value: The faculty regulations require an above-average degree in mathematics or physics but do not say whether a Master's is needed.
entry_route.quote: must have an above average degree in Mathematics or Physics

english_waiver.value: Non-German applicants must document sufficient knowledge of German or English under the faculty regulations; no test score or India exemption is named.
english_waiver.quote: for non-German applicants, documentation of sufficient knowledge of German or English

notes: Acceptance is by the doctoral committee after a HISinOne application with a signed doctoral agreement. The faculty regulation (PromO 2016, courtesy translation) is shared with mathematics. The physics page names no tuition, GRE, TOEFL or IELTS rule and no funding rule. Structured programmes are listed on the graduate-school pages.
